// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// A permission slip's ANSWER is a named child, a named household and a decision
// an adult made about that child: CREDENTIAL_NEVER, exactly as a message is. The
// FORM is school text and is ADULT_READABLE; this is not the form.
export async function consentTally() {
  return db.consentResponse.count({ where: { answer: "GIVEN" } });
}
